title: $1.9M grant will support KU research on boosting drought tolerance in crops
summary_en: A new National Science Foundation grant will bring $1.9 million to KU to test specific types of microscopic soil fungi for their potential to build drought tolerance in wheat and rice.
title_cn: $1.9M grant will support KU research on boosting drought tolerance in crops

title: Two Lawrence-based filmmakers among recipients of 2026 Rocket Grants
summary_en: Filmmakers Lourdes Kalusha-Aguirre and Sean Kenealy are among the 10 recipients of this year's Rocket Grants. Each recipient will receive $6,000 for a total of $60,000 in funding for public art projects in the Lawrence and Kansas City area.
